title: Shoeshine-stand ukulele players and tiples
summary: Playing for fun at the stand, other ukulele players, and seeing a tiple with the Jesters.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: What would you do at a shoe shine stand?
Shining shoes, pushing around for it.
And did you play a uke too?

Yeah, I started with a musician. I started with, with, with, with, with, with, with, uh, Voinel Joseph. That's the last drummer Clayvon William had. He had a brother who was for drumming, named Alton Joseph, but he played ukulele too. And, uh, what's the other brother name? I can't call his name, but died. I don't know. They had, they had a drummer who used to play with Buddy P.T. He's a Joseph. I don't know. He's a wonderful drummer. I can't remember. I can't call Buddy P.T. But he went blind. You never heard of Von Al Joseph? I haven't heard of him until. That's Clayvon's last drummer. That's after Bull Leg left.
Yeah. But when you played the ukulele there, did people give you money or?
No, we just used to.
Just getting your kicks, huh?
Getting our kicks on the stand. Oh, I see.
Well, I guess business was slow sometimes.
No, well, I just, we used to be, serenade and just be happy, you know, be happy. But I love the music. But did that advertise it?
Did the people come? Well, yeah, we had a regular trade anyway. Oh, I see. I thought maybe that was like a ballon hill.
No, we just had that. Just was fun, huh? in those days. Like who? I just had the fun because there used to be some great ukulele players come around there in those days.
Like who? Oh, I could.

Felt, boy, all I know the nickname was Wesley. And he left here. Another one, we call him Black Freddy. The other day, those fellas could play. You know, they used to come around, just come around and play.
Yeah, they had tipples and all kind of funny ukuleles, ain't it? 10-string, did you ever see a 10-string ukulele?
I saw, I saw that. I saw that with the Justice. J-E-S-T-E-R-S. They came here and started working at the Famous Doe. That's the first time I saw a tipple.
Yeah.

But they started at Steve Lloyd Cannell. They had a place out here, it's popular old... Chez Paris. Yeah, that's where the Justice started at. They came here from away and then they wound up at the Famous Doe.
Yeah, well they had tipples, ukulele, and that kind of thing. Yeah, first time I saw a tipple.
I did a fella to play it too.
